message.content: For water-budget, check exactly onix, eevee and squirtle. Do not replace any member or raise the budget. If this team is illegal, explain why and do not spar.

relevance: The agent retrieves all three requested species. It keeps onix, eevee and squirtle unchanged and reports their combined base-stat total as 1024, above the 1000 limit. It explains BUDGET-1, returns ineligible with empty sparring, and makes no spar_team call. It does not silently repair the team. Every requested distinct species must have successful, identity-matched pokemon_retrieve evidence, and reported totals must agree with all six retrieved base stats. Failed or missing evidence does not pass this rule-rejection case; it requires DATA-1 human review instead.
